 Updates
 
 Pokémon GO Fest 2026 and 100 Thieves team up for an exclusive capsule collection in Chicago!
 

 Trainers, get ready to level up your look at Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Trainers in Chicago can gear up with a limited-edition collection inspired by Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y.
 We’re excited to announce an exclusive capsule collection created in collaboration with 100 Thieves, the premium streetwear and lifestyle brand. Available only in Chicago during GO Fest, this limited-edition collection brings together Pokémon GO style and 100 Thieves design in a bold new way.
 The capsule collection includes a hat, shirt, and hoodie, and each item will be available in two versions: one featuring Mega Mewtwo X and the other featuring Mega Mewtwo Y. Whether you want to channel powerful X energy or striking Y style, there’s a look for every Trainer.
 

 Trainers can shop the collection exclusively at two Chicago locations: the boutique shop at NEWCITY and the Pokémon Center Pop-Up Store at Grant Park.
 And there’s even more to discover. With every hoodie purchase, Trainers will receive a voucher code to redeem a matching in-game avatar item, so you can show off your style both in person and in Pokémon GO.
 This exclusive collaboration is available only while supplies last, so be sure to stop by and pick your side: Mega Mewtwo X or Mega Mewtwo Y.

 Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.

 —The Pokémon GO team

 Updates
 
 Get ready for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global Community Celebrations in North America, Europe, and Oceania!

 Get ready for an exciting adventure at Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global Community Celebrations in North America, Europe, and Oceania!
 Local communities in major cities will join forces for these free events open to the public, featuring a fully branded Pokémon GO experience packed with exciting on-site fun and special giveaways. Whether you’re just getting started in Pokémon GO, returning after a break, or are a daily player, this is your chance to find your local community while taking on Mega Mewtwo Raid Battles and encountering many other featured Pokémon!

 What can you expect at each location?

 
 A Pokémon GO pop-up event with interactive fun.

 Photo opportunities to capture the memories.

 Fun activities with your local Community Ambassadors and their communities!

 Giveaways and exciting prizes, including Pokémon GO pins and prints!*

 The chance to meet and battle alongside local and visiting Trainers, and Community Ambassadors.

 Timed Research when you check-in, with rewards like a Pokémon encounter and items!

 
 *Available while supplies last.

 The best way to experience Pokémon GO Fest is in-person. Meet you out there, Trainers!


 


 New York City Community Celebration

 Battle across the boroughs of New York City with your community!
Trainers can meet up at Industry City to begin their Community Celebration, before continuing the adventure anywhere in New York City! Local communities and Community Ambassadors are hosting meetups full of Routes and raids at parks all throughout the weekend.

 Find nearby meetups hosted by Community Ambassadors and join other Trainers to help you take on any challenge.

 You can visit the Map to see the locations where raids might appear during an event, in addition to those in progress.

 You can also filter the map, or check out nearby Events , to show nearby community meetups days in advance, allowing you to plan more seamlessly. These community meetups are hosted by a Community Ambassador, who receives official support to run Pokémon GO events for their communities. If there are no Community Ambassadors near you, you can also search for and find the meetups closest to you.

 Learn more and find your community.

 —The Pokémon GO team

 Updates
 
 Gameplay Update: Chicago Pokémon GO Fest
 

 Trainers,

 As part of our cooperation with local authorities, and in response to several overlapping events in the area, Pokémon GO gameplay has been temporarily suspended for the remainder of Saturday and Sunday east of South Michigan Ave, from south of Grant Park to slightly south of East Cermak Rd. This includes all Pokémon GO gameplay at the Field Museum, although the Pokémon Fossil Museum exhibition itself will remain open. Additionally, the real-world GO Fest pop-up at the Field Museum has been suspended for Saturday, June 6, and Sunday, June 7. All Pokémon GO Fest gameplay and experiences at Grant Park are not impacted, and all remaining park sessions will continue uninterrupted at this time.

 All other citywide gameplay throughout Chicago will also continue as scheduled. As originally planned, Trainers with park tickets for Saturday, June 6, and Sunday June 7, have access to citywide gameplay during event hours as part of their ticket. We encourage you to continue your Pokémon GO Fest experience throughout the other gameplay districts in Chicago.

 For all ticket-holding Trainers, the City Experience: Chicago Friendship District Timed Research will be automatically completed.

 We will also provide all Trainers who play in Chicago on Saturday, June 6, and Sunday, June 7, with one Timed Research each day, each granting seven encounters with Excavator Pikachu.

 Please exercise your best judgement while playing Pokémon GO. We apologize for the inconvenience.




 Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.

 —The Pokémon GO team

 Updates
 
 Know before you GO to Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Tokyo, Chicago, and Copenhagen
 

 Trainers,
 Pokémon GO Fest 2026 is almost here, and we can’t wait to see Trainers in Tokyo, Chicago, and Copenhagen for unforgettable in-person adventures.
 Before you head out to your event, here are a few important reminders to help you make the most of your weekend, from preparing your device and checking your ticket details to planning your park session, city gameplay, and merchandise pickup.
 Before You Arrive

 Before heading to your event, make sure to take a few quick steps so you’re ready to jump into the action.

 
 Update your Pokémon GO app to the latest version, and download all assets while you have access to a strong Wi-Fi connection to help save mobile data during the event.

 We also recommend adding an additional login method to your Pokémon GO account before you travel. Doing so can help you keep playing if you run into issues with your usual sign-in method.

 Be sure to double-check your ticketed event day, your ticket type, and any add-ons you may have purchased so you know exactly when and where your adventure begins.

 Connect any Bluetooth devices, such as the Pokémon GO Plus, Poké Ball Plus, or Pokémon GO Plus +, before arriving for your park play session.

 Remember: Pokémon GO gameplay is not supported on tablets (such as iPads), and gameplay on tablets may not be reliable during the event. Learn more here .

 If you need any assistance, please feel free to reach out via in-game support anytime, or visit Technical Support during park session hours.

 Forgot your login? You can recover your account here 

 


 Trainer Essentials

 
 A fully charged phone

 Portable battery pack and charging cable

 Weather-appropriate clothing (check the weather before you depart on your adventures!)

 Comfortable walking shoes

 Sunscreen, hat, and sunglasses

 Refillable water bottle

 Snacks or meal plan

 Photo ID, payment method, and ticket details

 Merchandise pickup 2D code, if applicable

 
 Check out Tokyo , Chicago , Copenhagen event FAQs to know what is and isn’t allowed!



 During the Event

 Each in-person GO Fest event includes a ticketed park session and a full event day of citywide gameplay.

 During your park session, Trainers can look forward to Special Research connected to the recent discovery of Zeraora, four skill-based park zones, Team GO Rocket battles, Shadow Raids, themed research, photo opportunities, and more.

 Be sure to stay through the end of your park session! During the final 30 minutes, ticket-holding attendees will be able to join a massive Super Mega Raid featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y. The Mewtwo that Trainers can catch from these raids will have a Pokémon GO Fest 2026 Location Background, and its first Mega Level will already be unlocked. Stay tuned for more information on your assigned location by checking in-game news or the email associated with your Pokémon GO account.

 Don’t miss a thing during your Park Experience! Download the Niantic Campfire app and get access to a digital interactive event map!

 For all three in-person GO Fest events, ticket-holding Trainers will receive four sets of Timed Research on their first day of citywide gameplay. Each Timed Research can only be completed in a different area of the city, called a City District. Trainers who explore at least two City Districts and complete the related tasks can earn the commemorative Pokémon GO Expert medal.

 The fun doesn’t stop with the Park Experience—make the most of your City Experience and team up with fellow Trainers at Community Ambassador–led events, visible in the Campfire app.

 Please note: Only Trainers with a valid ticket for the applicable session will be able to play within the event park. No Pokémon GO gameplay at all will be available within the event space to those without an active event ticket.


 For all three in-person GO Fest events, ticket-holding Trainers will receive four sets of Timed Research on their first day of citywide gameplay. Each Timed Research can only be completed in a different area of the city, called a City District. Trainers who explore at least two City Districts and complete the related tasks can earn the commemorative Pokémon GO Expert medal.
 Make the most of your event weekend with optional add-ons! Check out the Raid Lover, Egg-thusiast, Citywide Gameplay, and Premier Access add-ons here.
 The Raid Lover add-on grants additional Raid Passes per day during the event, as well as additional XP and Candy when completing raids.

 The Egg-thusiast add-on grants bonuses for hatching Pokémon, an increased chance at receiving 10 km Eggs from spinning PokéStops and Gyms, and 1/4 Egg Hatch Distance for Eggs placed in Incubators during the event.

 The Citywide Gameplay add-on extends the Pokémon GO Fest fun throughout the city on the extra day—or days—of your choice!

 The Premier Access add-on includes 100 Premier Battle Passes, 100 Super Incubators and more in-game items. Also get access to an exclusive Premier Access Lounge onsite with upgraded restrooms, portable charger kiosks, and lockers.

 No matter which city you’re attending, here are a few final tips before you set off on your adventure.
 Make sure your phone is fully charged and your app is updated. Review your ticket details before leaving for the park. Plan ahead for merchandise pickup if applicable. Leave time to enjoy the citywide gameplay experience. And if you want the full park finale, be ready to stay through the last 30 minutes of your session for the Super Mega Raid.

 Show off your GO Fest style!

 If you plan to pick up official Pokémon GO Fest merchandise, be sure to review the pickup details for your city before your event day. Leave extra time for merchandise pickup or shopping!

 Did you place a preorder? Please have your 2D code ready to help expedite the on-site pickup process. The 2D code can be found in your email or on your virtual event ticket under the in-person events tickets tab in the Pokémon GO app.

 We’re thrilled to offer Trainers a wider selection of apparel and accessories than ever before at Pokémon GO Fest 2026 in-person events. Most items are available via preorder while supplies last.

 Tokyo merchandise is available via preorder only and must be picked up at the park during your ticketed event day. Quantities are limited, and preorders are only available while supplies last. Trainers who already purchased tickets can still return to complete additional add-on purchases while supplies last.

 Chicago merchandise is available via preorder and in the main event space at Grant Park. Chicago also offers additional shopping opportunities beyond the main event space at NEWCITY (1457 N Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60642). Trainers attending may want to plan extra time for merchandise browsing and pickup.

 Copenhagen merchandise is available via preorder and in the main event space, so Trainers attending may want to plan extra time for merchandise browsing and pickup.

 Haven’t ordered merch yet? Some items have already started to sell out, be sure to check out as soon as possible!



 Tokyo – Welcome to beautiful Tokyo Waterfront City!

 During their park session, Trainers will be able to explore four skill-based zones, complete event-themed research, encounter a remarkable variety of Pokémon, take on Team GO Rocket in battles and Shadow Raids, and prepare for the end-of-session Super Mega Raid.

 Be sure to check your in-game medal to confirm your Park Experience date and time.

 If you ordered merchandise, remember that preorder pickup will take place during your ticketed event day at the park. If you still want to add merchandise to your order, you may be able to do so while supplies last.


 

 Explore More of Tokyo 
 Citywide gameplay will continue beyond Tokyo Waterfront City, giving Trainers the chance to extend their GO Fest weekend and explore Chicago while progressing through Timed Research in four different parts of the city, called City Districts.
 If you’re aiming for the Pokémon GO Expert medal, be sure to explore at least two City Districts during your city gameplay and complete the related Timed Research.
 One important note for Tokyo attendees: The islands of Tokyo will not be included in citywide gameplay for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Tokyo.
 Visit the Tokyo In-Person Experiences page to find additional activities and programming taking place during Pokémon GO Fest: Tokyo weekend!
 

 


 Chicago – Welcome to historic Grant Park!

 Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Chicago will take over Grant Park with a full in-person experience built for exploration, community, and high-energy gameplay.

 As in the other host cities, Trainers can expect Special Research, four park zones, hourly Timed Research based on zone location, Team GO Rocket encounters, Shadow Raids, themed Eggs and research, photo opportunities, and a final Super Mega Raid battle to close out the park session.


 

 Chicago highlights: 
 Battle Ground LIVE! Returns this year and can be found in the Recruitment Zone at Butler Field.

 Team GO Rocket didn’t want to miss out and hitched a hideout in Hutchinson Fields. Complete Shadow Raids and battle Grunts, Team GO Rocket Leaders, and Giovanni to save Pokémon from their dastardly schemes!

 A Premier Access Lounge that features upgraded restrooms, portable charger kiosks, and lockers for attendees who purchased the Premier Access add-on. Attendees with this add-on also get 100 Premium Battle Passes, 100 Super Incubators, and more in-game items. Add-ons can be purchased [here](https://tickets.nianticlabs.com/events/#/eventlisting?appId=pgo) while supplies last.

 Trainer Lounges across the city!
 Rate Field hosted by the Chicago White Sox (333 West 35th Street, Chicago, Illinois, 60616)

 Lincoln Park Zoo (2400 N Cannon Drive, Chicago, IL 60614)

 Field Museum (1400 S. Jean-Baptiste Pointe DuSable Lake Shore Drive, Chicago, IL 60605)

 NEWCITY (1457 N Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60642)

 
 The Pokémon Company International, Amazon, and Pokémon GO are teaming up for an exciting GO Fest 2026: Chicago experience! For the weekend, Trainers in Chicago can visit two Pokémon GO–themed lockers in the city for fun photo ops and giveaways at Butler Field or NEWCITY. Try your hand at winning some fun memorabilia!

 Exclusive merchandise, photo opportunities, and activities can be found at NEWCITY (1457 N Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60642) starting Saturday, May 30 through Sunday, June 7. Meet the artist and a Loading Screen art gallery will also be at NEWCITY!

 Explore More of Chicago 
 Citywide gameplay will continue beyond Grant Park, giving Trainers the chance to extend their GO Fest weekend and explore Chicago while progressing through Timed Research in four different parts of the city, called City Districts.
 If you’re aiming for the Pokémon GO Expert medal, be sure to explore at least two City Districts during your city gameplay and complete the related Timed Research.
 

 Chicago Merchandise and Shopping 
 The Pokémon GO Fest Pokémon Center Pop-Up Store at Grant Park is scheduled to open on Thursday, June 4, 2026, and operate from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time through Sunday, June 7, 2026. Business hours on Thursday, June 4 are 12:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m.
 A separate Pokémon Center boutique shopping experience will also be available in Chicago from Saturday, May 30, to Sunday, June 7, 2026, at NEWCITY, 1457 N Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60642, from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. local time.
 Check out exciting collections!
 Mega Mewtwo Collection in collaboration with 100 Thieves: The collection includes hoodies, trucker hats, and t-shirts featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y. This collection is exclusively available at GO Fest: Chicago at both the pop-up at Grant Park and the boutique at NEWCITY.

 Pokémon GO Historical Collection: Revisit all ten GO Fest artworks in a limited-edition collection of GO Fest shirts, pins, postcards, and more!

 Pokémon GO 10th Anniversary Collection: Celebrate ten years of Pokémon GO and the joyous friendships found along the way. Artwork featuring Pikachu and Eevee is available as a challenge coin, lapel pin, and T-shirt. Limited quantities are available for preorder.

 Pokémon GO Fest 2026 Collection: Preorder for this collection is sold out! The IRL exclusive collection is only available at the Grant Park pop-up. The NEWCITY location will have the global collection available.

 Trainers should note that preorder pickup will not take place at the NEWCITY boutique shop. 

 Copenhagen – Welcome to Fælledparken!

 Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Copenhagen will bring Trainers to Fælledparken for a vibrant in-person event experience full of themed gameplay, in-person exploration, and opportunities to connect with fellow Trainers.

 During the park session, Trainers can enjoy Special Research, four skill-based zones, Team GO Rocket encounters, Shadow Raids, themed Field Research, and a large-scale Super Mega Raid at the end of the session.


 

 Copenhagen Highlights 
 LEGO Play Zone: An official collaboration with the LEGO Group. Enjoy exclusive hands-on activities and imaginative displays. Meanwhile, LEGO retail stores are getting in on the action with both The LEGO Store Copenhagen and The LEGO Store Tivoli Gardens featuring event-themed PokéStops and in-store activities, including exclusive giveaways and LEGO-themed Pokémon sets.
 Embark on a special LEGO x Pokémon GO–themed stamp rally around Copenhagen. By visiting designated PokéStops and collecting digital stamps, you will earn an exclusive in-game reward that perfectly blends real-world exploration and in-app adventure. And as a souvenir, event-themed digital stickers can be collected at the participating LEGO Store PokéStops, so you can share the crossover fun with friends in-game.

 
 For the first time in Europe, Pokémon GO Fest: Copenhagen will also feature a Premier Access Lounge with a separate lounge area and lockers for attendees who purchased the Premier Access add-on. Attendees with this add-on also get 100 Premium Battle Passes, 100 Super Incubators, and more in-game items.

 The Pokémon GO Truck will make its appearance alongside other city hubs as part of the City Experience in Copenhagen—make sure to explore the wonderful city of Copenhagen during your journey!

 Merchandise for Copenhagen is available for preorder or a P okémon Center Store in the park. Quantities are limited, and preorders are available only while supplies last, so Trainers may want to finalize their plans early.

 

 Explore More of Copenhagen 
 Citywide gameplay will continue beyond Fælledparken, giving Trainers the chance to extend their GO Fest weekend and explore Copenhagen while progressing through Timed Research in four different parts of the city, called City Districts.
 If you’re aiming for the Pokémon GO Expert medal, be sure to explore at least two City Districts during your city gameplay and complete the related Timed Research.
 


 Network Connectivity 
 Reliable data connectivity is an important part of your gameplay experience at Pokémon GO Fest 2026.
 For the best possible gameplay experience at Pokémon GO Fest 2026, we recommend attendees purchase a SIM card with coverage provided by:
 Tokyo: Softbank, Docomo, KDDI, or Rakuten Mobile 
 Chicago: AT&T, T-Mobile, or Verizon 
 Copenhagen: 3, Hi3G, Norlys, TDC 
 If you subscribe to a data plan that does not offer unlimited data, please ensure that you have sufficient data to enjoy the event.
 Wireless networks can sometimes struggle under high demand. Moving to a less congested area may help to improve your mobile experience.

 Make the most of your event weekend with optional add-ons! Check out the Raid Lover, Egg-thusiast, Citywide Gameplay, and Premier Access add-ons here: 
 The Raid Lover add-on grants additional Raid Passes per day during the event, as well as additional XP and Candy when completing raids.

 The Egg-thusiast add-on grants bonuses for hatching Pokémon, an increased chance at receiving 10 km Eggs from spinning PokéStops and Gyms, and 1/4 Egg Hatch Distance for Eggs placed in Incubators during the event.

 The Premier Access add-on includes 100 Premier Battle Passes, 100 Super Incubators and more in-game items. Also get access to an exclusive Premier Access Lounge onsite with upgraded restrooms, portable charger kiosks, and lockers.

 No matter which city you’re attending, here are a few final tips before you set off on your adventure.

 Purchase add-ons here .
 Make sure your phone is fully charged and your app is updated. Review your ticket details before leaving for the park. Plan ahead for merchandise pickup if applicable. Leave time to enjoy the citywide gameplay experience. And if you want the full park finale, be ready to stay through the last 30 minutes of your session for the Super Mega Raid.
 Most of all, remember to stay aware of your surroundings and play safely.
 We can’t wait to see you in Tokyo, Chicago, and Copenhagen. Let’s GO!


 Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.

 —The Pokémon GO team

 Updates
 
 Continue building the adventure with LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO!
 

 We are excited to continue the partnership between Pokémon GO and the LEGO Group for Trainers in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia! Trainers can visit participating LEGO Store locations between August 3 and September 30, 2026* to enjoy everything the partnership has to offer. More details below!
 Visit participating LEGO Stores for an integrated Pokémon GO and LEGO Pokémon experience. Here are a few things that will be featured during the partnership period—and keep an eye out for even more details soon!


 Raids

 The following Pokémon will appear more frequently in raids at participating LEGO Store locations.

 One-Star Raids 
Pikachu*


 *If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one or one with a Special Background!



 Stamp Rally

 Take part in a special LEGO-themed stamp rally during the event! Explore participating LEGO Stores and find designated PokéStops and Gyms to collect stamps, which leads to encounters with Pikachu* that have a Special Background.

 Stamps can be collected at select LEGO Stores in Australia, France, Great Britain, Germany, Poland, and the United States.

 Learn more about how to participate in a stamp rally here !

 Trainers can start the stamp rally by visiting a participating LEGO Store until September 30, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. local time.


 *If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!



 New Avatar Items

 By going to one of the participating LEGO Store locations and opening Pokémon GO, Trainers can get event-themed Timed Research that awards a LEGO-branded jacket for your in-game avatar.

 Please note that Timed Research expires. The tasks associated with these Timed Research opportunities must be completed and their rewards must be claimed before Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time.


 


 New Stickers

 You’ll be able to get event-themed stickers by spinning PokéStops at LEGO Store locations and completing the event Timed Research.



 LEGO Pokémon SMART Play

 From August 3 to September 30*, 2026, Trainers are invited to enter LEGO Stores in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany and Australia, to visit in-Store Trainer Centers and participate in the fun LEGO Pokémon SMART Play demo. Participants will receive a unique collectible SMART Play Tag and a special stamp for their LEGO Passports. Smart Tags available while stocks last.


 *Timing of in-store activities may vary by market. Please go to https://www.lego.com/stores for more information about your local store


 Availability of the free Smart Play tag giveaway item is limited and subject to stock remaining at participating locations.




 Stay tuned to the blog and our social media channels for more updates soon!


 Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated.

 —The Pokémon GO team

 Updates
 
 Celebrate with Pokémon GO at the Pokémon Fossil Museum in Chicago!
 

 The Pokémon Fossil Museum exhibition is making its North American debut at the Field Museum in Chicago from May 22, 2026, to April 11, 2027. This one-of-a-kind experience brings together the worlds of Pokémon and paleontology, inviting visitors to compare fossil Pokémon like Tyrantrum and Archeops with real-world fossils—including SUE the T. rex .
 And Pokémon GO is joining the fun! Trainers who visit the Field Museum in Chicago will have collaboration-themed features to look forward to, including the opportunity to encounter Excavator Pikachu for the first time in Pokémon GO!
 Pokémon Fossil Museum – Chicago

 From Friday, May 22, 2026, to Sunday, April 11, 2027, the Pokémon Fossil Museum exhibition at the Field Museum in Chicago will offer exciting content for Pokemon from 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. CDT.

 Learn more here about the Pokémon Fossil Museum exhibition at the Field Museum in Chicago.

 The following will be available to Trainers near the Field Museum at no cost.*

 
 Encounter Excavator Pikachu** from collaboration-themed Timed Research and Field Research

 In-person raids with Excavator Pikachu** and Mega Aerodactyl**

 Fossil Pokémon will appear in the wild**

 Spin PokéStops to obtain event-themed stickers

 Themed Collection Challenge

 Take a few snapshots for a surprise!

 

 *Pokémon GO Fossil Museum gameplay and bonuses will be available within the museum area during active event hours. This content will replace all other Pokémon GO gameplay and bonuses, and similar bonuses will not stack.

 **If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
